```yaml
name: Danger PR Comment

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]

jobs:
  danger-pr-comment:
    uses: numbata/danger-pr-comment@v1
    with:
      github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ruby-version: 3.1
      danger-version: 5.0.0
      bundler-cache: true
```
